title: Material cues at two rendering qualities
description: Synthetic study with a runnable WebXR app: finding and identifying objects by their material at low and high rendering quality. 16 invented participants whose background drives the invented outcomes. Real agent runs use Claude Code + the built-in WebXR runtime.

actions.name: identify
actions.description: In an identification trial, name the material of the object marked by the yellow ring and cone

params.material: glossy ceramic, matte ceramic, brushed metal, plastic or glass

app.instructions: look orbits the viewpoint around the table: polar about 60 looks down at the table, 89 is almost level with its top. Objects off screen are listed without a position; turn towards them to see them. In the search trials, select the three target objects. In the identification trials a yellow ring and cone mark one object (list_objects marks it too); answer with act identify and its material.
